EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

THIS EMPLOYEE AGREEMENT (the "Agreement") made as of the {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(frappe.utils.nowdate()) }}, by and between Aspada Marketing Pvt Ltd (hereinafter referred to as the "Company"), whose principal place of business is located at C-3A/23A, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058 and {{ frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee).employee_name }}, a resident of {{ frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee).current_address }} and having PAN {{ frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee).pan_number }} and Aadhar No. {{ frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee).custom_aadhar_number }} (hereinafter referred to as the "Employee").

WHEREAS, the Company wishes to procure the services of the Employee under the terms and conditions set forth, and the Employee wishes to be employed on these terms and conditions.

WHEREAS, the parties to this Employee Agreement wish to enter into a written expression of their relationship as Employer and Employee.

THEREFORE, in consideration of the agreements contained in this Employee Agreement, the parties, intending to be legally bound, agree as follows:

ARTICLE I: Employment

1.1 Employment: The Company agrees to employ Employee, and Employee accepts employment with the Company, on and subject to the terms and conditions set forth in this Employee Agreement.

1.2 Term: The employment of the Employee shall commence on the Effective Date as of the {{ frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee).date_of_joining }}, and shall continue until terminated by either party in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement.

ARTICLE II: Duties

2.1 Position and Duties: The Company agrees to employ Employee to act as its employed personnel having a designation as “{{ frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee).designation }}". Employee shall be responsible for performing the duties as described in the Induction program. Employee agrees to serve the Company faithfully and to the best of his ability during the term of employment, under the direction of the Company's Board of Directors. The Company and Employee may jointly change the nature of Employee's duties and job title from time to time.

2.2 Time Devoted to Work: The Employee acknowledges and agrees that during the term of this Agreement, the Employee shall devote all of his business time, attention, and energies solely to the business of the Company.

ARTICLE III: Place of Employment

3.1 Place of Employment: Employee shall perform his duties under this Employee Agreement at C-3A/23A, Janakpuri, Delhi 110058, India, as well as any other office of the Company located in Delhi NCR.

3.2 Reimbursement for Business Expenses: Subject to the approval of the Company, the Company shall promptly pay or reimburse Employee for all reasonable business expenses incurred by Employee in performing Employee's duties and obligations under this Employee Agreement, but only if Employee properly accounts for expenses in accordance with the Company's policies.

ARTICLE IV: Termination of Employment

4.1 Termination of Employment. Employee's employment hereunder may be terminated under the following circumstances:

4.1.1 Voluntary Termination: Employee may terminate his employment by providing an advance written notice of 60 days to the Company.

ARTICLE V: Confidential Information

5.1 Disclosures While Employed by the Company: Employee acknowledges that, in performing duties on behalf of the Company prior to this Employee Agreement, and in performing the duties required by this Employee Agreement, Employee has made use of, acquired, and added to, and will be making use of, acquiring and adding to the confidential and proprietary information of the Company and/or its Affiliates.

5.2 Confidentiality Obligations: Employee agrees that during the term of this Agreement and thereafter:

  • a) Employee shall not use, disclose, or reproduce the Company's Confidential Information for any purpose other than in the ordinary course of employment.
  • b) Employee shall take reasonable measures to protect the confidentiality and security of the Confidential Information.
  • c) Employee shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information upon termination of employment.

ARTICLE VI: Protective Covenants

6.1 Non-competition: Employee acknowledges that by reason of the character and nature of the Company's and/or the Affiliates' business activities and operations, it is necessary for Employee to agree not to engage in certain specified activities in the Territory (as defined below) for a period of 12 months following termination.

6.2 Non-solicitation of Customers: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of 24 months following termination, Employee shall not:

  • a) Directly or indirectly solicit, contact, or provide services to any customer of the Company for purposes of offering products or services in competition with those offered by the Company.
  • b) Use or disclose confidential customer information for any purpose other than in the ordinary course of business for the Company.

ARTICLE VII: Waivers

The waiver by either party of a breach of any provision of this Employee Agreement shall not operate or be construed as a waiver of any subsequent breach.

ARTICLE VIII: Entire Agreement

8.1 No Other Agreements: This instrument contains the entire agreement of the parties pertaining to the employment of the Employee by the Company.

8.2 Prior Agreements: This Employee Agreement supersedes any prior employee agreements pertaining to or connected with or arising in any manner out of the employment of Employee by the Company.

ARTICLE IX: Amendment of Agreement

No change or modification of this Employee Agreement shall be valid unless it is in writing and signed by the party against whom the change or modification is sought to be enforced.

ARTICLE X: Acknowledgment

Employee acknowledges that he has had the benefit of independent professional counsel with respect to this Agreement and that the Employee is not relying upon the Company, the Company's attorneys, or any person on behalf of or retained by the Company for any advice or counsel with respect to this Agreement.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Employee Agreement in duplicate on the date and year first above written.

Aspada Marketing Pvt Ltd

By:
